criterion_scope: Engineering acceptance targets, not DisplayPort normative limits. No fitted threshold may replace a component guarantee.

review.evidence_required: Preserve location-qualified public AUX values and explicit unknowns
review.result_evidence: M5P8 primary-source electrical envelope preserved; no normative loading or M5-voltage inference

review.requirement: Instantaneous common-mode/transient range at chosen tap
review.evidence_required: Bound actual connector DC plus AC peaks, hotplug and ground offset
review.result_evidence: 0.3V periodic CM and 3.6V step are explicit simulation assumptions, not a universal connector envelope

review.evidence_required: Component and PCB leakage bounds across voltage, temperature and power states
review.result_evidence: TLV9031 bias is typical-only; protection and board leakage across full voltage/temperature not bounded

review.evidence_required: Guaranteed input and protection C plus board parasitic budget
review.result_evidence: Separate common-mode and differential input capacitance modelled, but typical values are not guaranteed C/matching maxima

review.evidence_required: Analytical error bound and deterministic mismatch sweeps below fixed target
review.result_evidence: 14.2101mV reproduced; perfect resistors leave14.2082mV. New E8 CM gain0.0148107 exceeds0.005 target

review.evidence_required: All input/rail/backend current paths and executed transient bound
review.result_evidence: Positive-rail clamp removed in fail-safe candidate, but E7 negative excursion leaves its0..5.5V contract; generic clamps/rail path are not qualified component bounds

review.evidence_required: Standoff, overshoot, resistor/cap pulse and rail absorption evidence
review.result_evidence: TPD1E01B04 headroom unresolved; ESD4010.95pF maximum and5.5V standoff still permit24V typical TLP clamp; comparator snapback performance unspecified

review.evidence_required: Revalidate input-only sense and forward-only digital boundary
review.result_evidence: Input-only analogue sense, fixed independent supplies and forward-only isolated output retained; no external output-feedback hysteresis or AUX/HPD driver

review.evidence_required: Qualified connectors, stackup, launches and pass-through rules
review.result_evidence: 100ohm through-path rules retained; no released connector/stackup/launch implementation

review.evidence_required: Symmetric branch and extracted parasitic/matching budget
review.result_evidence: Pre-resistor branch<=2mm remains a target; no extracted geometry or parasitic-matching guarantee

review.evidence_required: Single DP analogue reference and no added USB earth/backfeed path
review.result_evidence: DP-referenced analogue side and isolated digital USB side; no DP_PWR power or protective-earth lifting; implementation review remains separate

review.requirement: Backend voltage compatibility and exact acquisition unit
review.evidence_required: Exact available model, input limits and sustained sample mode
review.result_evidence: Narrowed to conditioned-input Logic8 or DSLogicU3Pro16; full clock/export/host acceptance not closed; CmodA7 USB-UART not assumed fast FIFO

review.evidence_required: Explicit no-silent-loss mechanism and host/storage duration budget
review.result_evidence: Saleae documents memory/backlog stop and loop discard; no exact 180s worst-activity recorder/export receipt or complete loss contract validated

review.evidence_required: Concrete non-DP signal, loading, timing and power-sequence acceptance plan
review.result_evidence: Fixed loading/matching/timing/backfeed criteria with no DP device; conditional M5P10 only after release and separate authorization

review.evidence_required: Preserved 327 tests plus matching, transient and decoder regressions
review.result_evidence: Independent matching, RC/PWL, AC, convergence, powered-off, tolerance and circuit-to-W1 tests; frozen M5P7/M5P8 code retained

review.evidence_required: Executed circuit model and separately complete construction schematic review
review.result_evidence: Numerical alternative executed; no SPICE claim. Compound original item remains unresolved because construction design is not released

review.evidence_required: Exact part with all design-critical input, timing and power-off bounds
review.result_evidence: TLV9031DBVR is a conditional lead, not selected: no guaranteed C matching/max, bias max or low-overdrive dispersion; negative/off and idle behavior need closure

review.evidence_required: Worst-case bounds for all offset, leakage, tracking, parasitic and timing contributors
review.result_evidence: All required contributors enumerated; guaranteed total is null, not zero, because critical component/PCB bounds are absent; no RSS replacement

review.evidence_required: Exact pins, power, protection, connectors and checks sufficient to construct
review.result_evidence: Withheld under conditional release rule; numerical network is not construction EDA or ERC/DRC

review.evidence_required: Qualified actual MPNs, package, source, stock and single-unit cost
review.result_evidence: No build BOM released while critical parts/backend/power/connectors are unqualified; candidate volume prices are not a complete one-unit total

review.evidence_required: Actual source/sink/observer transient execution with convergence and raw evidence
review.result_evidence: E0-E10 RC/PWL waveforms executed; reference equations and1ns/5ns convergence checked; synthetic results and assumptions retained

review.evidence_required: Complete nominal and worst accepted waveform-to-AUX/MST/W1 behavior without suppressing errors
review.result_evidence: Bounded-offset and jittered profiles complete synthetically; nominal no-hysteresis profile remains CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE with idle-transition errors; decoder unchanged
